title.en: Kind veterinary team with follow-up lapses

text.en: Most pet owners praise the vets and nursing staff for being welcoming, polite, and compassionate toward sick animals. Reviewers highlight vets like James for their clear explanations and thoughtful advice. However, two clients had very negative experiences, reporting poor follow-up communication and perceived indifference to patient needs.

Clients frequently note the kind and considerate care given to elderly dogs and cats with chronic health challenges. Reviewers describe a veterinary team that handles anxious animals with gentleness and aims to minimise distress during examinations. Pet parents feel comforted by the reassuring manner shown during urgent and routine visits.

Several reviewers report effective emergency treatments, including swift relief for acute dental abscesses and thorough initial assessments. In contrast, two clients were dissatisfied with treatment outcomes, citing repeated courses of medication that failed to resolve persistent skin allergies and an overall lack of diagnostic progression.

q.en: Does the Norbury clinic accommodate emergency cases?

a.en: Yes, clients report that the team accommodated urgent emergencies, including dental abscesses and sudden pet illnesses.
Reviewers note good appointment availability and swift booking for routine consultations and health check-ups.
Out-of-hours veterinary emergency care is redirected to a partner 24-hour hospital when the Norbury clinic is closed.
